title: Culture Sample Preparation and Storage
summary: Culture samples are diluted in Milli-Q H2O and stored in unautoclaved 1.6-mL Eppendorf tubes. The diluted culture sample is a chemical entity resulting from the dilution process. The culture samples and diluted culture sample are related to the storage containers, indicating a practical application of the culture samples. The entities involved in this cluster are primarily related to laboratory methods and tools, as well as chemicals used in the process.
